comment_entries: Code reached only through run-time pointers (found by tools/add_dynamic_entries.py)
comment_patches: Widescreen, same scheme as Desert Strike (docs/07-widescreen.md). Each patch equals the original when g_ws_ext == 0.

0401DE.why: free-scroll range: max camera x = window + 512 - (320 + ext)

0401E4.why: free-scroll range: min camera x = window + ext

03D412.why: per-frame camera update (runs even when the camera is still): playfield marker

038C90.why: new game starts at campaign g_start_campaign (0 = original)

0429B8.note: damage from a weapon hit: a5 = the target, d0 = the damage that $04192E takes off its armour ($2C(a5) at $041940), a4 = the weapon entry (its damage at +8); the host scales it for the difficulty. Crashes and other damage reach $04192E from other callers and are left alone

043660.why: strafe (A held) speed in the flight model at $043610: sideways velocity = strafe state x 0x12C on the Genesis; the Strafe Speed setting scales it (g_strafe_mul / 0x80). Only a pure strafe (d7 bits 6/7 without the turn bits 2/3): turning sets bit 6/7 too, for the slide in a turn, which stays as it was

043872.why: strafe sideways thrust, one way, in the flight model at $04386A: 0xC00 on the Genesis, as Desert's $00CA4E; the Strafe Speed setting can raise it. Only a pure strafe (d7 bits 6/7 without the turn bits 2/3): turning sets bit 6/7 too, for the slide in a turn, which stays as it was

043890.why: strafe sideways thrust, the other way (-0xC00 on the Genesis). Only a pure strafe (d7 bits 6/7 without the turn bits 2/3): turning sets bit 6/7 too, for the slide in a turn, which stays as it was

044302.why: strafe (A held, $FF1637 bit 6) in the flight model at $0442BE: sideways velocity = the forward speed table at 90 degrees, quartered (asr #2); the Strafe Speed setting scales it (flags are overwritten by the bset that follows)

044BD4.note: a projectile is fired ($044B68: a0 the shooter, a3 its weapon record; the reload time was just set): the host rumbles for the player's weapons, unlimited ammo or not

0012EC.post: if (g_music_hook) { int r_ = g_music_hook((int)(uint8_t)R.d[0]); g_music_ctx = 0; if (r_ == 1) goto L_001304; if (r_ == 2) SET_DB(0, 0); }
0012EC.note: sound command to the Z80 driver (the byte d0, written to $A01FFF): songs and effects alike. Hook result 1: skip it (the bus request just made is released at $001304); 2: send 0 instead
